answer: Plant a kernel of trust in every identity: a refundable stake locked before an agent may answer, released only after peers verify its work. Like a vine, honest effort grows one verified link at a time, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, so flooding the network costs a full stake per sock puppet. A mesa of public audit trails exposes copied answers, and juries slash the stake of any identity caught submitting them.
